Layout size = width times height from the replay header; queen distance = maps.json queen_spawn_distance (wrapped Manhattan distance between the two queen heads at spawn). (a) main and v31 separately, opponent rating 1900 or more, cells 1200 or fewer: wipe-outs over games for distance 10 or less and for more; wipe-outs per layout. (b) and (c): raw replays, raw rounds 0 to 60 inclusive. A meeting = a dragonDeath with engine reason 3 (head-on) of a dragon that is not the one whose turn it is (the last turnStart actor), where that actor is alive and belongs to the other team; the mover is the actor; lengths are body lengths just before the death. Count meetings by mover side. (b) the 34 early wipe-outs with battle id 1316833 or lower against all other main (v31) games on the layouts that have such a wipe-out in that code. (c) every main (v31) game on a layout of 1200 cells or fewer, by opponent rating band; also per opponent in the 2100+ band.

how_to_count: Games: our_code main or v31, last raw round 499, ended on the queen rule, only their queen alive at the end, layouts with queen_spawn_dead_end false; Portals apart. Turn starts of their queen in raw round 100 or later after our queen died in an earlier event. Seen at a turn start = some living head of ours has wrapped column distance 3 or less and wrapped row distance 3 or less to her head; test this at every one of her turn starts from the start of the game. Age = current raw round minus the raw round of her last seen turn start (this one included); classes 0-20, 21-50, 51-100, over 100, never. Near = the smallest path distance from her head to any living head of ours (steps across open tile sides and through portals, dragons ignored) is 6 or less; also 7 to 12. Mirror: the same with the sides exchanged, in the full games we won on the queen rule with only our queen alive.
